copy.storyHeading: From one lorry to a full renovation crew
story: Suria Bina started in 2011 with one lorry, a rented lot in Setia Alam, and a refusal to quote work we could not stand behind. The first clients were neighbours — a wet kitchen, a leaking bathroom, a terrace that needed rewiring before a family could move in.
Fifteen years later we employ our own crew rather than subcontracting to whoever is free that week. The scale changed. The rule did not: say what it costs, then build what you said.

seo.homeDescription: Suria Bina renovates terrace, semi-D and bungalow homes across Setia Alam, Shah Alam and Klang. Itemised quotations, own crew, fixed prices. Get a free site visit.
seo.aboutDescription: Suria Bina is a family-run renovation contractor in Setia Alam, founded in 2011 — 18 full-time crew who believe a quotation should be a promise, not an opening bid.

process.title: Site Visit & Quotation
process.text: We come to your house, measure, and listen to what you actually want. You get an itemised quotation — every item priced separately, so you can see exactly what you are paying for and cut what you don't need.

process.title: Drawings & Approval
process.text: 3D drawings before anything is hacked, so you can see the result and change your mind for free. Where structural work or MBSA submission is needed, we arrange the engineer and the paperwork.

process.title: Build & Handover
process.text: Our own crew, not subcontracted strangers. Weekly photo updates on WhatsApp. Any variation is quoted and approved in writing before we continue — no surprise bills at the end.
